business_summary: Indo National Limited manufactures and distributes dry cell batteries, rechargeable batteries, flashlights, and general lighting products in India. It offers alkaline and zinc batteries; battery-operated and rechargeable torches; LED lighting, including battens, spotlights, down and panel light, rechargeable bulbs, and regular bulbs. The company also provides spike guards and flex boxes; mosquito swatters and mosquito repellents under the Swooper brand, and liquid vaporizers; electrical products; other FMCG products; and razors and blades under the DORCO brand. In addition, the company engages in investment activities, solar power supply, and the manufacturing of air purifiers. The company was formerly known as Nippo Batteries Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Indo National Limited in April 2013. Indo National Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.
